note: Open-data fixtures. Downloaded files are untrusted data: each lives in its own directory under data/, which is git-ignored. Terms were checked on the source page on the date recorded.

sources.title: Online Retail (UCI ML Repository #352), UK online retailer transactions 2010-12-01..2011-12-09
sources.attribution: Chen, Daqing (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
sources.use: Real transactional data: text ids, mixed-case ids, returns/negative qty, zero prices, exact duplicate rows, null customers, per-item price variation. No line-total column (S1 derives one in a planted-error copy).

sources.title: SpamAssassin public mail corpus 2003-02-28 (easy ham, hard ham, spam): real raw RFC-822 emails
sources.licence: Public corpus offered for testing mail-processing systems (messages from public fora or sent with the knowledge they may be published); readme asks not to feed it into live mail systems
sources.attribution: The Apache SpamAssassin Project public corpus
sources.use: Parser robustness on real, messy emails (multipart, charsets, HTML-only, odd headers) and the false-positive rate of the injection scan on genuine business-like mail. Parsed offline only; never sent anywhere.

sources.title: VNE Stainless MTR portal: stratified sample of 25 certificates (3.1 stainless fittings)
sources.licence: NOT VERIFIED: public anonymous portal; internal testing only, do not redistribute
sources.fetch: downloaded with the user's own scraper logic (Plaetorius/mertia-data): index pages 1,30,60,90,115 (first 5 certs each), 1 request/second
sources.use: real MTR PDFs (text layer and scans) to exercise PDF/OCR, injection scan and report; no ground truth
